answer_1.quote: Medical text generation has been widely applied to various scenarios, including clinical note generation, report summarization, and patient question summarization
answer_1.outputs: clinical notes, radiology report impressions, summarized patient questions

answer_2.quote: We apply DOCLENS with the three evaluators to benchmark multiple medical generation systems on three tasks

answer_3.quote: We also apply instruction-following models to compute the metrics, including proprietary and open-source models

answer_4.quote: We invite five medical experts to the human study and assign three of them to label each pair of selected system outputs
answer_4.guideline: We ask the medical experts (1) what percent of the claims can be entailed by each output, and (2) which output they think is more complete
